source_graphs.source_artifact_rule: Resolve every views.npz through the authoritative raw_artifact_manifest.csv and verify absolute path, byte size, and SHA-256 before loading. Never choose another attempt directory by recency.
source_graphs.reference_predictions: same-dataset same-seed G00/H00 clusters from the authoritative locked transform manifests
source_graphs.confirmed_predictions: same-dataset same-seed G04/H05 clusters from the authoritative locked transform manifests

base_affinity_contract.view_preprocessing: row-wise L2 normalization using the exact Night-6C/Night-6D H05 implementation
base_affinity_contract.kernel: the exact existing H05 self-tuning kernel; no reimplementation drift is permitted

definitions.A_g_v: symmetric sparse H05 affinity for graph g in {G00,G04} and one of its three views
definitions.six_affinities: the three A_g_v matrices from G00 followed by the three from G04 in the fixed view order

required_parity: spectral(S_G00) must reproduce the authoritative G00/H05 partition for every dataset and seed
spectral(S_G04) must reproduce the authoritative G04/H05 partition for every dataset and seed
C02 must be numerically equal to the arithmetic mean of all six A_g_v matrices
all source observation IDs and ordering must match exactly between G00 and G04

spectral_contract.numerical_failure_policy: preserve the failed cell and continue remaining preregistered cells; never repair a candidate-specific failure after labels are opened

candidates.scientific_role: Night-6D confirmed structure and default structure unless a dual-graph candidate clears the material complexity gate

candidates.equivalent_formula: arithmetic mean of all six A_g_v matrices

candidates.formula: for each edge, 2*S_G00*S_G04/(S_G00+S_G04) when both operands are positive, otherwise 0
symmetrize((row_normalize(S_G00) + row_normalize(S_G04))/2) as (M+M^T)/2, then set diagonal to zero

For each spot i and graph g, r_g(i) is the mean of the three pairwise Jaccard similarities among the k10 neighbor sets from its three views. Let w_g(i)=(r_g(i)+1e-12)/(r_G00(i)+r_G04(i)+2e-12). Form directed M_ij=w_G00(i)*S_G00_ij+w_G04(i)*S_G04_ij; output (M+M^T)/2 with zero diagonal.
weight_diagnostics_required: correlation with library size or labels forbidden before lock

candidates.formula: For every edge, let m be the number of positive values among the six A_g_v entries. If m=0 output 0; otherwise output median(of positive entries)*(m/6). Set diagonal to zero.

Initialize P_g from S_g with off-diagonal entries divided by twice the off-diagonal row sum and diagonal fixed to 0.5. Initialize K_g from each row's top-10 off-diagonal S_g entries, row-normalized. For t=1..10 update each graph simultaneously: U_g=K_g*P_other*K_g^T; retain diagonal plus the top-10 off-diagonal entries per row with observation_id tie-break; renormalize to the same P convention. Output symmetrize((P_G00+P_G04)/2) and set diagonal to zero.

reporting: every per-seed absolute metric and paired delta
mean, median, standard deviation, win count, exact sign-flip p, and paired bootstrap interval per dataset

rules: mean delta Q versus G00/H00 is at least 0.005 on every one of the four datasets
mean delta NMI versus G00/H00 is strictly positive on every dataset
mean delta ARI versus G00/H00 is strictly positive on at least three of four datasets and is not below -0.005 on any dataset
paired Q wins are at least 4/5 on A1 and tonsil and at least 7/10 on D1 and P22
median paired delta Q is strictly positive on every dataset
the spatial protection gate passes on every dataset
no candidate cell is missing or silently replaced

dual_graph_complexity_gate.material_preference_over_C00: Either (A) dataset-balanced macro mean delta Q exceeds C00 by at least 0.0075 and no dataset mean Q is more than 0.002 below C00, or (B) the candidate's worst-dataset mean delta Q versus G00/H00 exceeds C00's worst-dataset mean delta Q by at least 0.005, its macro delta Q is not below C00, and no dataset mean Q is more than 0.002 below C00.
dual_graph_complexity_gate.reason: A dual-graph method requires two encoder runs in future use and must earn that extra cost rather than win by a negligible development fluctuation.
